definitions.explanation: A priest who serves at a Shinto shrine, performing rituals, prayers, and ceremonies. The head priest of a shrine.

examples.japanese: {神主|かんぬし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{祝詞|のりと}→祝詞：30669_norito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦あげた→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: The Shinto priest recited a prayer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{神主|かんぬし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{祓|はら}い→お祓い：15835_oharai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had the shrine priest perform a purification ritual for me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{代々|だいだい}→代々：05899_daidai⟧{神主|かんぬし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧⟦{家系|かけい}→家系：10130_kakei⟧だ。
examples.english: It is a family line that has served as Shinto priests for generations.

notes:
A Shinto priest who serves at a ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧ (shrine), performing rituals, prayers, and ceremonies. This is the most common everyday term for a shrine priest.

ETYMOLOGY:
{神|かん} (god/deity) + ⟦{主|ぬし}→主：30578_nushi⟧ (master/owner). Literally "master of the gods" — the person responsible for serving the shrine's deity.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {神主|かんぬし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{祝詞|のりと}→祝詞：30669_norito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦あげて→あげる：00546_ageru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: have the priest recite prayers
- {神主|かんぬし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{祓|はら}い→お祓い：15835_oharai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: have the priest perform purification

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{宮司|ぐうじ}→宮司：12654_guuji⟧: chief priest of a shrine (formal title used in shrine hierarchy)
- ⟦{神職|しんしょく}→神職：20491_shinshoku⟧: Shinto clergy (collective/formal term)
- ⟦{巫女|みこ}→巫女：12408_miko⟧: shrine maiden
- ⟦{住職|じゅうしょく}→住職：15520_juushoku⟧: Buddhist temple priest (different religion)

{神主|かんぬし} is casual/everyday; ⟦{宮司|ぐうじ}→宮司：12654_guuji⟧ is the official title within the shrine ranking system.
